svg.title: The Wheel of Life, and where to find the pig
svg.desc: Labelled schematic of the bhavachakra: three animals at the hub, a pale and dark band of rising and falling beings, six realms of rebirth, and the twelve links of dependent origination round the rim, all held in the claws of Yama.
svg.text: The Wheel of Life, and where to find the pig
You will meet this on a wall at Tabo. Read it from the middle outwards — the hub causes everything else.
the pale half of this band rises through
the realms, the dark half falls
The twelve links round the rim
2 formation — a potter at the wheel
4 name and form — figures in a boat
5 the six senses — a house with windows
7 feeling — an arrow in the eye
12 ageing and death — a corpse carried away
Find the hub first. Everything in the rings outside it follows from those three animals.
